name: browzer
description: The artifacts Claude publishes open in browzer, a Chromium page in a kitty split beside the session; /browzer opens any page there

show.title: What to show
show.description: page: the published artifact at claude.ai (sign in once, in browzer); file: the HTML file Claude wrote, from disk

onPublish.title: Open on publish
onPublish.description: Show each artifact as Claude publishes it; off, only /browzer opens pages

layout.title: Where it opens
layout.description: When no browzer is running yet: a kitty split beside this window (vsplit, hsplit), a new kitty tab, or a new OS window

focus.title: Take the keyboard
focus.description: Move the focus to browzer when it opens; off, it stays with Claude

browzer.title: browzer command
browzer.description: The browzer to run, when it is not the one on PATH
